provenance.method: Reviewed NHS inform/Scottish Government ARFID information on 2026-09-05; retained clinical and nutritional boundaries.

name: NHS inform — ARFID (Scotland)
description: Scotland public health information about avoidant/restrictive food intake disorder (ARFID), possible presentations, complications and treatment context.
intended_use: Scotland-specific clinical information route when restrictive eating may need assessment rather than self-diagnosis.
audience_or_context: Scotland; people seeking public information about ARFID and appropriate clinical support.
limitations: Reading an ARFID description cannot establish a diagnosis.
Treatment can involve multiple disciplines; ND Oracle does not choose exposure, nutritional, psychological or medication treatment.
Sensory food preference alone is not automatically ARFID.
cost_or_access_notes: Free public information; local service access varies.
